character.name: Idle
character.prompt: A friendly young adult farmer protagonist for a cozy fantasy farming game. Full-body human, taller and less chibi than a short NPC, wearing a broad golden straw hat, blue overalls over a pale shirt, brown work boots. Wholesome, charming and readable. Match classic warm 2D farming pixel-art sprites, compact silhouette with the whole body fitting inside 16 pixels wide by 32 pixels high including hat. No tools, no background, no text.
